text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp came to an end once again this year.
Buena Vista's dedication and effort
were truly incredible—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...? 
Huh, did you already hit your soba-making quota?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, this place is...
choice_data_list: So I was a soba artisan, huh...
Guess I was a master soba chef all along.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a dream...!
I'm so sorry!
choice_data_list: You must be pretty wiped out, huh.
You must be pretty wiped out, huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Looks like it.
I really pushed myself hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back to the academy,
I'm going to take a nice, long rest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having achieved further growth at the summer camp,
Buena Vista returned to the academy, where—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A truly honorable notification
was awaiting Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: An invitation to an exhibition race...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Top-tier Umamusume from overseas will be participating—it is, in a sense, a dream race!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The organizers reached out to ask
if you, Buena Vista, would represent Japan
and participate in the race.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In both popularity and skill, you're number one in Japan right now.
—Everyone expects you to be the face of this era!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That exhibition race is like a massive Grand Prix,
where Umamusume chosen by fans from various countries
face off against one another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that dreamlike biennial race
will be held here in Japan this year.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"The announcement is yet to come,
but it will surely draw immense anticipation from racing fans."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Howevvver! On very short notice,
it has been decided that it'll be held next month...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, just between us...
it seems most of the Umamusume actually entering
are those whose competitive careers have settled down.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, your Twinkle Series schedule takes top priority.
Make sure to consult thoroughly with your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "—They're holding a Dream Race! I wonder if Buena-chan will enter?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"‘I heard legendary lineups show up every time...!
I wonder if we'll see a match between her and Buena-chan!?’"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"To Buena Vista—"
"To Buena-san—"
"We want Buena-chan to run"...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hey,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to race.
Because—
choice_data_list: "Because you want to live up to their expectations"... right?
"Because I want to meet expectations"... right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If I compete against Umamusume from all over the world and win...
I'll definitely live up to everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We'll be able to satisfy everyone.
So—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among the major issues, such as a tight racing schedule
and accumulated fatigue...
the most crucial point is—
choice_data_list: Because you look like you're getting anxious.
Because you seem a little anxious.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I see, maybe I... was rushing things.
――Thinking I had to live up to their expectations even more.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The expectations keep growing bigger and bigger...
No matter how much I live up to them... I can't see the finish line.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I had completely lost sight
of what I should be aiming for...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
All those expectations...
They were weighing me down.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...I'll talk to them. As long as I'm with Trainer,
we can work through... anything.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
I—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (—Talk? How?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The expectations are getting heavy... and I'm feeling impatient.
Should I tell Trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Show me the absolute best view out there!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Show me the absolute best view, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(To Trainer, who has believed in me
this entire time?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I don't... want to say it.
Not to you... To you of all people."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everything I've received so far...
The expectations, the trust... those sparkling feelings—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll be painted over.
—No... I absolutely... hate that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You believe in me,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then... will you leave it to me?
I'll manage things on my own, I promise.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I'm not a kid anymore, you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Please let me run in the upcoming exhibition race after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to fully live up to everyone's expectations and win...
and make so many people happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is putting their hopes in me...
I don't want to step down. ...Please!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you believe in me, I'm...
invincible. You know that, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looked at positively, facing overseas Umamusume could serve as a great stepping stone toward winning the international invitational race, the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I believed in Buena Vista when she said she wanted to overcome it on her own.
She's always done that up until now... because she's a strong Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Then let's adjust the training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got!
—I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you... the view of victory
that everyone is longing for."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista flashed a beaming smile.
From that expression... I felt certain
this choice wasn't a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, her entry into the exhibition race was officially confirmed.
